body:
1. In lib/doctor.mjs line 1202 checkTicketStore: change strict check to `if (!parsed.ok || (parsed.exitCode !== undefined && parsed.exitCode !== 0))` so clean ticket doctor output from @adlc/tickets passes.
2. In lib/doctor.mjs line 20 checkNodeVersion: enforce Node >= 22.19.0 to align with package.json engines and bin/node-launcher.sh.
3. In lib/bootstrap.mjs line 282: probe resolvedAgyBin directly via execFileSync(resolvedAgyBin, ['--version']) rather than requiring the external 'which' utility.

Verification: npm test && node bin/agb.mjs doctor
title: Fix doctor false store corruption, enforce Node >= 22.19, and avoid which in bootstrap
